title: download_blob 64 MiB cap is hardcoded with no caller override
description: download_blob caps responses at 64 MiB with a hardcoded constant. The error returned is ResponseTooLarge with no indication it is a client-enforced limit. Callers downloading large attachments (video, archives) will hit this and file bugs; there is no workaround without forking. Adding a limit parameter later is a breaking API change. Consider either accepting an optional limit parameter at construction time or exposing the constant as a public API so callers know it exists.
